data.narrative:
Vermeer is a Series A-stage company in Defense & Security founded by Brian Streem, with $10M raised to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 same-sector peers at the same or adjacent stage, comprising 8 private companies and 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Key private peers include Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-Progression uses the $10M total raised as a baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implying a $20M valuation. Peer-Median analysis across the 10-company comp set yields a $1.0B median valuation, with a range of $125M to $3.0B. The five largest comps shown (Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Castelion and Defense Unicorns each at $1.0B) are all Series B-stage companies.

The triangulated analysis suggests a valuation range of $17M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $510M. The material spread reflects stage and maturity gaps within the comp set; Vermeer's Series A status sits well below the median Stage B peers, supporting valuation pressure toward the lower end. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, product differentiation within a crowded frontier-defense sector, and customer concentration risk.
